info.name: Moody's Data Buffet Baskets Search API

params.name: query
params.description: Search query string to match against series names, descriptions, mnemonics, and metadata.

params.name: geography
params.description: Filter results by geographic area code (e.g., US for United States, GB for United Kingdom, CN for China).

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by data source identifier (e.g., BLS, BEA, IMF, Eurostat).

params.name: category
params.description: Filter results by data category (e.g., GDP, Employment, Inflation, Housing).

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of results to skip for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

items.docs: Searches the Data Buffet repository for available series matching the specified criteria. Supports filtering by keyword, geography, source, and category.
